operations.title: The initial semiring does not lift to the full Carrier groupoid
Noncommuting D4 source automorphisms obstruct a monoidal lift of the pi_0 semiring with U as unit
operations.body: Automorphisms of a monoidal unit commute by interchange. The quadrilateral Carrier generator U has source automorphisms containing D4, whose rotation and reflection do not commute. Therefore the conditional initial semiring on pi_0 cannot lift to a monoidal product on the full D4-resolved Carrier groupoid with U as unit. The pi_0 theorem itself is unaffected.
